diploLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Your chewing echoes off the trees. Something out there heard. (encounters more likely tomorrow)
🧭 Larry is back from the south. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)
❓ Village talk: Shaker isn't really from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, according to A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands. You haven't heard Shaker's own story yet.
